dataset: Muntin Cost Index — US Domestic Wild-Landings (NOAA FOSS)
attribution: Muntin Cost Index (muntin.digital); underlying data NOAA Fisheries FOSS (public domain)
note: US COMMERCIAL WILD landings (value + pounds) by seafood species group, summed to national. This is the domestic pair for each seafood import stream — but a WILD-CATCH domestic figure set beside a largely-FARMED import stream, so it is NOT a like-for-like apparent-consumption share: the wild-vs-farmed seam is named per group and, where the US wild fishery is negligible (octopus, mahi, trout), domestic_wild_minimal flags it. Value is nominal ex-vessel landings dollars, never a delivered or retail price; pounds are round/live weight landed, never edible yield. Confidential state-species rows are withheld by NOAA and degrade the sum by ABSENCE, never zero-padded. Descriptive of the landings record — it is not a forecast.

groups.label: Shrimp
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: US wild penaeid (Gulf/South Atlantic) + pandalid (cold-water); imports are mostly farmed — the wild-vs-farmed seam is wide here.

groups.label: Salmon (Pacific wild)
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: US wild = Pacific/Alaska (chinook, coho, sockeye, pink, chum). Atlantic salmon is farmed (US wild Atlantic landing is $0/confidential every year) and is EXCLUDED from the wild figure.

groups.label: Cod
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Atlantic + Pacific cod, both wild; CODFISHES ** is the aggregate rollup.

groups.label: Haddock
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: US wild Atlantic haddock.

groups.label: Halibut
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Pacific halibut dominates the value; Atlantic/California/Greenland roll up.

groups.label: Dover sole
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: US 'dover sole' = Pacific dover sole specifically — matched alone, NOT the whole 15-species sole group.

groups.label: Lobster
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: American (Maine) + spiny lobster roll up; both wild.

groups.label: Crab
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Blue, dungeness, king, snow/tanner and more roll up; all wild.

groups.label: Scallop
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Sea + bay scallop, wild-harvested.

groups.label: Clam
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Wild clam landings; note some clams are also aquacultured (a seam on the domestic side too).

groups.label: Squid
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Pacific (market) + Atlantic (Loligo/Illex) squid, wild.

groups.label: Octopus
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: US wild octopus landing is tiny (~$0.3M) — octopus on menus is overwhelmingly imported; degrades toward absence.

groups.label: Snapper
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Red snapper + the wider Lutjanidae group roll up (the import code is broad too).

groups.label: Grouper
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Black/gag/red and the wider Epinephelidae group roll up.

groups.label: Mahi-mahi (dolphinfish)
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: AFS common name is dolphinfish. US wild landing is small (~$2.7M) — mahi is largely imported; a wide seam.

groups.label: Tuna (all)
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Yellowfin/bigeye/albacore/bluefin/skipjack roll up; a loin is a cut of the same landing.

groups.label: Ahi tuna (yellowfin + bigeye)
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Ahi = yellowfin + bigeye specifically — matched as that pair, not the whole tuna group.

groups.label: Trout (wild)
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: US wild trout landing is tiny (~$0.1M, mostly lake trout). Menu trout is overwhelmingly farmed (NASS aquaculture) — degrades toward absence on the wild side.

groups.label: Anchovy
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Pacific/northern anchovy, wild (reduction + bait fishery); small food landing.

groups.label: Sardine
groups.source: NOAA Fisheries FOSS — commercial landings (collection=Commercial), summed across states to national
groups.wild_note: Pacific sardine / pilchard, wild; landings swing with the stock's boom-bust cycle.
